sources.title: [2512.22437] EmoCtrl: Controllable Emotional Image Content Generation
sources.snippet: An image conveys meaning through both its visual content and emotional tone, jointly shaping human perception. We introduce Controllable Emotional Image Content Generation (C-EICG), which aims to generate images that remain faithful to a given content description while expressing a target emotion. sources.title: EmoCtrl: Controllable Emotional Image Content Generation
sources.snippet: Existing methods enhance emotion awareness but lack fine-grained content control. To address this limitation, we introduce Controllable Emotional Image Content Generation (C-EICG) and propose EmoCtrl, which enables simultaneous control of content and emotion.
